SellingJournalEntry has no deliveryDate, shippingCost, or orderNote fields. Those controls stay local to the form, while saved records preserve the existing shape and use the save timestamp for soldAt so dashboard month metrics continue to update.

The form reads the existing rayGia:inventory array when available, seeds the existing default inventory only when that key is absent, and persists a quantity deduction across repeated saves while preserving unrelated inventory records. The read-only shared icon registry does not expose point_of_sale or shield_with_heart; the screen uses the closest existing registry symbols for those visual affordances.
